title: Adaptive Power Iteration Method for Differentially Private PCA
abstract: arXiv:2602.11454v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study $\left(\epsilon,\delta\right)$-differentially private algorithms for the problem of approximately computing the top singular vector of a matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ where each row of $A$ is a data point in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$. Following Dwork-Talwar-Thakurta-Zhang (STOC 2014), we consider the privacy model where neighboring inputs differ by one single row. We give a novel algorithm that achieves beyond-worst-case guarantees for input matrices with low coherence, which is a structural property of matrices in many applications, including but not limited to i.i.d. data. Our algorithm contributes to the extensive literature on private power iteration methods, where we introduce a new filtering technique which adapts to this coherence parameter. translated_title: 面向差分隐私主成分分析的自适应幂迭代方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究用于近似计算矩阵 $A\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ 顶部奇异向量的 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私算法，其中矩阵的每一行是 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的一个数据点。遵循 Dwork-Talwar-Thakurta-Zhang（STOC 2014）的工作，我们考虑相邻输入仅相差一行的隐私模型。我们提出了一种新颖的算法，对于具有低相干性的输入矩阵能够实现超越最坏情况的保证，而低相干性是许多应用中矩阵所具备的一种结构性质，包括但不限于独立同分布数据。我们的算法为私有幂迭代方法方面的大量文献做出了贡献，其中我们引入了一种能够适应相干性参数的新过滤技术。我们的工作区别于并补充了 Hardt-Roth（STOC 2013）的工作，后者在更严格的隐私模型（相邻输入……）下实现了超越最坏情况的保证。
tldr: 本文提出一种自适应的差分隐私幂迭代算法，通过引入适应矩阵相干性参数的新过滤技术，对低相干性矩阵实现了超越最坏情况的顶部奇异向量近似保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive differentially private power iteration algorithm that introduces a new filtering technique adapting to the matrix coherence parameter, achieving beyond-worst-case guarantees for approximating top singular vectors of low-coherence matrices.
